body_html:
I hail from the music rich country of Jamaica and have been a professional DJ since 2003! Since I’ve always loved working with my hands “DJ Chiro” was a very natural alter ego to assume. I take the responsibility of keeping a party going seriously and am a big fan of proper preparation with our clients. Flexibility is key in the entertainment biz and I pride myself on my ability to incorporate multiple genres and timelines in my sets so no one feels left out!

 

Personal Favorites: Reggae/Dancehall, Soca, Tropical House, Hip-Hop, Electronic, 80’s & 90’s
